title: How To Spot a Fake Natural Transformation
summary: The auto-captions are unusable gibberish, so this note relies on the title and description. NH warns about fake natural transformations on YouTube fitness: impossibly fast gains with poor training and diet. He says they drive young lifters to body dysmorphia and steroids, while real natural bodybuilding takes time and effort but wins in the end.
claims: Impossibly fast gains, with physiques that should take years appearing in months on poor training and no real diet, are a sign of a fake natural transformation
Fake natural transformations have been a business on YouTube fitness since its beginnings
Fake natural transformations directly cause body dysmorphia and steroid use in many young lifters
Natural bodybuilding takes time and effort, but it always wins in the end
